title: Qualitative integral supported localization and reduction data
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, field k with l invertible, a k-scheme X with structure morphism t, closed immersion i:Z→X and open immersion j:U→X, and a supplied family F n : SfFiniteLocalization l E n k i j [def-sf-localization-stage-data], define SfIntegralLocalizationComparisonData l E k hl t i j F. It consists of supported localization on the actual integral constructible categories, comparisons to the specified completed images and completed pullbacks, closed/open image reductions, open and closed pullback reductions, exceptional reductions and their exceptional-counit and open-unit equations. This is qualitative data only: no Tor bound, no limit existence and no existence is asserted. The fields except closed_pull_reduction are exactly the corresponding fields of SfIntegralLocalization, with finiteStages supplied as F.
